newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Deposition bids for Foilmark.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Deposition bids for Foilmark.

text.p: Advanced Deposition Technologies Inc said Wednesday it had made a takeover offer for Foilmark Inc.
It did not disclose the terms but said the offer was made at a premium to Foilmark's current market price. Foilmark shares closed at 4-1/8 Tuesday.
Advanced Deposition said it had sent the offer to Foilmark's board.
Advanced Deposition said it is considering at least two other acquisition possibilities.
Foilmark, based in Newburyport, Mass., makes hot foil, holographic films and related hot stamping equipment.
Advanced Deposition commercializes new technologies and products related to thin films, coatings, dielectric film and vapor depositions.
